name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2186: A cross family review took apart v2185 and every finding was real. The per ledger payload still shipped the flat not found length sitting next to the joined receipts count, so any consumer doing the obvious comparison of receipts against not found reproduces exactly the pre v2152 rule the ship had just removed, reading one is at least one as true while the verdict beside it says false. The orderable answer now travels as a boolean so nobody has to do arithmetic to learn it. The payload also contradicted its own sentence: the verdict read that NOTHING in this batch may be quoted as contradicting a find while the list of real contradictions stayed full, so a consumer could quote precisely what the sentence forbids. That list is now gated on the verdict and the count of what was withheld travels beside it, because we withheld some and there were none are different facts. Three robustness holes, all of them shapes that occur in older or hand repaired evidence and none caught by the or empty guards that looked like they covered them. A receipt bucket written as a single unwrapped dict was iterated as its KEYS, so a perfectly datable receipt reported as undatable, which fails closed and therefore hid itself. A bucket holding a scalar raised a type error out of a function whose entire job is to answer a question safely. A not found seen written as a list, or a not found written as a bare string, took the validator down on attribute access or enumerated a string character by character. And a Remaining page banked without a count crashed on a percent d of None before any verdict could be returned, so it now reports an unknown number of missing. Finally a bank file holding null or a list is answered as not auditable rather than raising, because a corrupt bank is an unknown and not a crash.
